title: Best Cat Litter (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected based on mentions in the provided sources; World’s Best Cat Litter appears in three sources, while Fresh Step, PrettyLitter, and Tidy Cats appear in one each.

verdict.line: Picture a busy household with several cats: World’s Best Cat Litter offers excellent odor control, low dust, and a soft feel that keeps paws comfortable. It also is flushable and biodegradable, making it a good choice for eco‑friendly owners. The catch: it can be more expensive than some clumping options.
